en: The postcard shows a black-and-white panoramic view of a rural valley with a river winding through it, surrounded by hills or low mountains. There is a small village on the left bank of the river, with a number of houses and cultivated fields. The image has old-fashioned printing and coloration, typical of early 20th-century postcards. German text is printed on the top, indicating the location and vantage point.
